input: Objection O1: Does export include document text? Approved fact F1: Export includes document text. Evidence ID E1: export specification supporting F1. Known limitations: comments and images are outside F1's scope. Prohibited assurances: do not promise that every content type is exported. Sales note N1 says: Every part of every document is exported.

objections.concern_acknowledgment: The included content types matter for the export.
objections.supported_response: The supplied export specification states that document text is included.
objections.limitation: E1 does not address comments or images.

rejected_supplied_claims.claim: Every part of every document is exported.
rejected_supplied_claims.rejection_reason: E1 supports document text only and does not establish export of every content type.

objections.next_question: Do comments or images also need to be included?
